The '''Roccus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Garis sector/Legends|Garis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Roccus]] and the [[Twin Suns Station (space station)|Twin Suns Station]].

==Behind the scenes==
Though referred to as the Roccus system in ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'', the appendix to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' lists only the Twin Sun Station.
